findings.summary: With --overwrite, stale per_subject.csv / per_pair.csv (when the run ends non-finite, exit 3) or a stale tta_spread.csv (--tta none over an earlier flip8 dir) stay in --out. summary.json 'outputs' lists only the current run's files. Optional: remove the LINEAR_EVAL_OUTPUTS files this run won't write, or have compare_tta check summary.json status/outputs.
